import csv,hashlib,json,sys,time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
repo=Path.cwd();started=time.monotonic()
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import check,record
from benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb import write_json
p=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/large_copy_component_feasibility_v3_20261013.json"
r=json.loads(p.read_text());assert r["status"]=="complete_all_large_copy_component_feasibility_verified"
for pin in r["checked"]: check(pin)
traces=[pin for pin in r["checked"] if Path(pin["path"]).name=="copy_split_trace.json"]
assert len(traces)==1
events=json.loads(Path(traces[0]["path"]).read_text())["events"]
families={i:e for i,e in enumerate(events) if e["large_copy_eligible"]}
namespins=[pin for pin in r["checked"] if Path(pin["path"]).name=="gene_names.txt" and Path(pin["path"]).parent.name=="payload"]
assert len(namespins)==1
payload=Path(namespins[0]["path"]).parent
names=Path(namespins[0]["path"]).read_text().splitlines();index={g:i for i,g in enumerate(names)}
n=len(names);owner=np.full(n,-1,np.int32);parent=np.arange(n,dtype=np.int32)
for i,event in families.items(): owner[event["members"]]=i
def find(i):
    i=int(i)
    while parent[i]!=i:
        parent[i]=parent[parent[i]];i=int(parent[i])
    return i
q,t,w=[np.load(payload/(name+".npy"),mmap_mode="r",allow_pickle=False) for name in ("sources","targets","weights")]
accepted=0
for start in range(0,len(q),1000000):
    a=q[start:start+1000000];b=t[start:start+1000000];v=w[start:start+1000000]
    fa,fb=owner[a],owner[b];mask=(fa>=0)&(fa==fb)&(v>=1.5)
    accepted+=int(mask.sum())
    for left,right in zip(a[mask],b[mask]):
        x,y=find(left),find(right)
        if x!=y: parent[max(x,y)]=min(x,y)
components={};size={};count=Counter()
for i,event in families.items():
    local={}
    for gene in event["members"]: local.setdefault(find(gene),[]).append(gene)
    groups=sorted(local.values(),key=lambda c:c[0])
    claimed=next(f for f in r["families"] if f["trace_ordinal"]==i)
    assert [len(c) for c in groups]==claimed["component_sizes"]
    assert sorted(g for c in groups for g in c)==event["members"]
    for c in groups:
        size[find(c[0])]=len(c)
        for gene in c: components[gene]=find(gene)
    localcounts={"families":1,"genes":len(event["members"]),"components":len(groups),"bounded_components":sum(2<=len(c)<=500 for c in groups),"bounded_component_genes":sum(len(c) for c in groups if 2<=len(c)<=500),"oversized_components":sum(len(c)>500 for c in groups),"oversized_component_genes":sum(len(c) for c in groups if len(c)>500),"isolated_genes":sum(len(c)==1 for c in groups)}
    assert localcounts==claimed["counts"]
    count.update(localcounts)
    if len(event["members"])>500: count.update({"over500_family_"+k:v for k,v in localcounts.items()})
assert dict(count)==r["counts"] and accepted==r["accepted_edges"]
pins=[pin for pin in r["checked"] if Path(pin["path"]).name=="reference_pair_stages.tsv"]
assert len(pins)==2
tables=[]
for pin in pins:
    with Path(pin["path"]).open() as f: tables.append(list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t")))
groups={}
for a,b in zip(*tables):
    x,y=index[a["native_gene_left"]],index[a["native_gene_right"]];fa,fb=int(owner[x]),int(owner[y])
    if fa>=0 and fa==fb:
        cx,cy=components[x],components[y]
        kind=("bounded_same_component_context" if size[cx]<=500 else "oversized_same_component_singleton_fallback") if cx==cy else "different_components_same_family"
        kind=("over500_family/" if len(families[fa]["members"])>500 else "bounded_family/")+kind
    elif fa>=0 and fb>=0: kind="different_large_eligible_families"
    elif fa>=0 or fb>=0: kind="one_large_eligible_family"
    else: kind="outside_large_copy_predicate"
    for key in ("transition:"+a["category"]+"->"+b["category"],"variant:"+b["category"]+"/"+b["stage"]):
        bucket=groups.setdefault(key,{"pairs":0,"component_context":Counter()})
        bucket["pairs"]+=1;bucket["component_context"][kind]+=1
assert groups==r["reference_strata"]
for pin in r["checked"]: check(pin)
output=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/large_copy_component_independent_readback_20261013.json";assert not output.exists()
write_json(output,{"status":"all_large_copy_components_rebuilt_by_independent_union_find","report":record(p),"counts":dict(count),"accepted_edges":accepted,"reference_strata":groups,"method":"Independent canonical-min-root union-find; no native component traversal imported; all 251 eligible family sizes, gene partitions and all 23934 paired reference rows rebuilt from checked edge arrays.","wall_s":time.monotonic()-started,"recipe":sys.argv[1],"defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False})
print(json.dumps({"status":"verified","over500_bounded_genes":count["over500_family_bounded_component_genes"],"prospective_context_pairs":groups["variant:FN/different_candidate_families"]["component_context"]["over500_family/bounded_same_component_context"]}))
